targets.notes: Billing document item, mirroring the VBAP/EKPO conventions: POSNR follows SAP numbering (Line_Number x10), pricing source columns are dropped as condition-driven, FKIMG carries the billed quantity.

fields.sap_description: Billing Document Number (staging key, must match the header)

dropped_fields.reason: SAP's own key is VBRP-POSNR; kept only as an informal source row identifier, not loaded
denormalized in the source -- VBRP has no company code field, it is inherited from the header (VBRK-BUKRS)
pricing is fully condition-driven in SD billing (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), no flat VBRP field -- same treatment as VBAP/EKPO
item-level discount condition record (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), not a stored field
tax condition record result (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), not a stored field -- the tax CODE is carried via VBRP-MWSKZ
